copy.m44: NEXALLOG’s four-stage methodology: assessment of management and operational data, identification of structural causes, a 90-day action plan and execution support.
copy.m45: D90 is NEXALLOG’s program for transportation and logistics companies. It starts with operational financial data, traces each deviation to its structural cause and culminates in a 90-day execution plan within the company. Every figure reviewed becomes an action with an owner, a deadline and an indicator to track progress and results.
copy.m47: Ninety days gives a transportation and logistics company time to organize management information, address priority causes and assess the impact on results while keeping day-to-day operations on track.
copy.m48: The plan is prioritized by impact, and NEXALLOG monitors execution alongside the responsible team. Work requiring specific technical expertise is carried out with our network of specialized partners.
copy.m49: Additional work, such as accounting and financial BPO with Numera or business cases for investment in automation and assets, is included only when the assessment identifies a need.
